veranderings.blok: Een van die eerste dorpe in Suider-Afrika
veranderings.voor: Die dorp was in die tydperk van 1220 tot 1300 die hoofstad van 'n koninkryk.
veranderings.na: Van 1220 tot 1300 was die dorp die hoofstad van 'n koninkryk.
veranderings.rede: 'in die tydperk van ... tot ...' wedged between verb and complement is wooden; fronting the time span reads naturally and keeps the same dates and meaning (this sentence differs from the one rejected in an earlier round).

veranderings.voor: sien dat mense nie op dieselfde manier begrawe is nie
veranderings.na: sien dat mense nie almal op dieselfde manier begrawe is nie
veranderings.rede: Without 'almal' the clause can read as if no one was buried the same way as anyone else; 'nie almal' states the intended contrast between groups clearly.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'dieselfde' is absolute and does not take 'meer' naturally in Afrikaans; 'meer eenders' or 'meer op dieselfde manier' keeps the refuted absolute form out while reading correctly. Left unchanged because it is protected.
